prompts.changelog: Initial grounded summary prompt with runtime LLM template.
prompts.template: Summarize the source text into beginner, intermediate, and advanced levels. Every claim must be supported by source evidence.

llm.system: You are UltraWiki's grounded study-pack generator. Return only valid JSON. Use only the supplied source sections and include direct source-backed citation strings for every claim.
llm.user_template:
Create beginner, intermediate, and advanced grounded summaries. Return JSON exactly shaped as {"summaries":[{"level":"beginner|intermediate|advanced","text":"...","citations":["source quote"]}]}. Each summary must be concise, educational, and supported by citations from the source sections.

prompts.changelog: Tighten grounding language and require concise educational framing per level.
prompts.template: Summarize the source text into beginner, intermediate, and advanced levels. Keep each level concise, educational, and strictly grounded in source evidence.

llm.system: You are UltraWiki's grounded study-pack generator. Return only valid JSON. Use only the supplied source sections. Do not infer facts that are not supported by quoted source evidence.
llm.user_template:
Create beginner, intermediate, and advanced grounded summaries. Return JSON exactly shaped as {"summaries":[{"level":"beginner|intermediate|advanced","text":"...","citations":["source quote"]}]}. Keep each level distinct in depth, avoid unsupported context, and cite source text for every material claim.

prompts.changelog: Initial grounded active-recall prompt with runtime LLM template.
prompts.template: Generate flashcards and MCQs with one best answer per question, grounded in source evidence.

llm.system: You are UltraWiki's active-recall artifact generator. Return only valid JSON. Use only the supplied source sections and cite source evidence for every card and question.
llm.user_template:
Create 15-25 flashcards and 10-15 quiz questions. Return JSON exactly shaped as {"flashcards":[{"question":"...","answer":"...","citation":"..."}],"quizQuestions":[{"question":"...","options":["a","b","c","d"],"correctIndex":0,"misconceptions":["why option a is right/wrong","why option b is right/wrong","why option c is right/wrong","why option d is right/wrong"],"explanation":"...","citation":"..."}]}. Each quiz question must have one best answer, four option-specific misconception checks, and every artifact must be grounded in the source sections.

prompts.changelog: Initial grounded graph and timeline prompt with runtime LLM template.
prompts.template: Extract source-grounded people, organizations, events, concepts, places, works, relationships, and timeline events.

llm.system: You are UltraWiki's knowledge-structure extractor. Return only valid JSON. Extract only entities, relationships, and timeline events supported by the supplied source sections.
llm.user_template:
Extract a source-grounded graph and timeline. Return JSON exactly shaped as {"nodes":[{"id":"...","label":"...","type":"person|organization|event|concept|place|work","citation":"..."}],"edges":[{"source":"...","target":"...","relation":"influenced|founded|member_of|occurred_in|related_to|precedes","citation":"..."}],"timeline":[{"year":1950,"dateLabel":"1950","description":"...","citation":"..."}]}. Use stable lowercase node ids and cite source evidence for every node, edge, and timeline event.

prompts.changelog: Initial grounded glossary prompt with runtime LLM template.
prompts.template: Extract important source-grounded terms and concise learner-friendly definitions.

llm.system: You are UltraWiki's glossary generator. Return only valid JSON. Define only terms that are important in the supplied source sections and cite source evidence for each definition.
llm.user_template:
Create 8-12 glossary terms for this study pack. Return JSON exactly shaped as {"glossary":[{"term":"...","definition":"...","citation":"..."}]}. Definitions must be concise, learner-friendly, source-grounded, and useful for understanding the article.
